verdict.rationale: There is no documented one-click or full-account export. Kit's V4 API does let you pull data out yourself: list endpoints use cursor pagination at up to 1,000 records per page, broadcasts return their full record including HTML content, and custom fields and stats are readable. The Kit MCP also exposes subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags and segments for reading, so a DIY extraction is plausible but the evidence never confirms it covers everything. Email stats are only returned for the last 5 years, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export (e.g. CSV/JSON download), confirmation that every data type is exportable, documented open export formats, independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful exit.
